verdict.rationale: Sentry documents Alerts [sentry-docs-17] with Slack, PagerDuty and webhook destinations [sentry-docs-18, sentry-docs-19, sentry-docs-25], so events can automatically trigger notifications and outbound actions. Ownership Rules [sentry-docs-22] add automatic routing, and Seer can send root-cause analysis to coding agents for automated fixes and PRs [sentry-docs-41]. Most of these citations are page titles only, so how rules are written (conditions, filters, action types) is not actually shown. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of rule conditions and action configuration, evidence of event-triggered actions beyond notifications and routing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
